text: Where would a hat go? Tap that part of our friend.
You found the head! A hat goes on the head.
Where would a bicycle helmet go? Tap that part.
That is the head. A helmet helps protect the head.
Which parts of the face can help us see a picture?
You found the eyes! Eyes can help us see.
Which parts of the face blink? Find them on our friend.
Those are the eyes. Blink, blink!
Which parts at the sides of the head can help us hear?
You found the ears! Ears can help us hear sounds.
Which parts of the head do earmuffs cover?
Those are the ears. Earmuffs help keep ears warm.
Which part of the face can help us smell a flower?
You found the nose! A nose can help us smell.
Find the part between the eyes and the mouth.
That is the nose, in the middle of the face.
Where does a bite of a snack go? Tap that part of the face.
You found the mouth! Food goes into the mouth.
Which part of the face makes a smile?
That is the mouth. Our friend has a smile!
Which parts can wave hello? Tap one on our friend.
You found a hand! Hands can wave hello.
Which parts do mittens keep warm? Tap one.
That is a hand. Mittens help keep hands warm.
Which part below the chest might rumble when we feel hungry?
You found the tummy! Sometimes a tummy makes a rumble.
Find the tummy in the middle of our friend, above the legs.
That is the tummy, above the legs.
Find a bendy part in the middle of a leg.
You found a knee! Knees help legs bend.
Where would knee pads go? Tap one spot on our friend.
That is a knee. Knee pads help protect knees.
Which parts wear socks? Tap one on our friend.
You found a foot! Socks go on feet.
Which parts have toes? Find one at the bottom of our friend.
That is a foot. Toes are part of a foot!
